# @remotion/noise 4.0.538

The package declares MIT in its package.json and ships no licence file of its own (checked in the npm tarball and in remotion-dev/remotion packages/noise at v4.0.538). The MIT text below is the one its sibling packages ship. The bundle also carries simplex-noise 4.0.1 (MIT, Jonas Wagner, second section) and random() from the core remotion package (LICENSE-remotion.md).
